# Folder Patterns

## Consulting Or Client Project

Use when the folder contains recaps, notes, deliverables, data exports, and strategy work.

```text
memory/
raw/documents/
raw/data/
raw/extracted/
workstreams/
deliverables/drafts/
deliverables/final/
logs/
```

## Software Project

Use when the folder is primarily a codebase.

```text
memory/
project-system/
raw/references/
workstreams/
logs/
```

Do not move source code into `raw/`. Keep codebase layout intact and add memory around it.

## Research Or Data Project

Use when the folder contains PDFs, datasets, notebooks, or research notes.

```text
memory/
raw/papers/
raw/data/
raw/extracted/
analysis/
outputs/
logs/
```

## Rule Of Thumb

Preserve the user's working structure when it is already meaningful. Add indexes and memory before moving files. Move files only after approval.
